title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your personal account, organization, team roles, and spending controls.

profile.cardDescription: Your name and email appear on member lists and activity. Username cannot be changed.
profile.securityDescription: After changing your password you will be signed out and must sign in again.
profile.passwordHelper: At least {{min}} characters; avoid common passwords
profile.statusPasswordUpdated: Password updated — please sign in again

general.sectionDescription: Name and tax ID shown across wallets and reports for this business.
general.readOnly: Only owners and admins can edit organization details.

members.emptyDescriptionManage: Add a teammate by their Digital Purse username.
members.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Ask an owner or admin to invite teammates.
members.ownerDemoteHint: Demoting an owner is only allowed when another owner remains in the organization.

roles.approverHint: Approve or reject large spends only

controls.sectionDescription: Limits for this organization (VND). Dual-control applies when transfer or withdraw is at or above the threshold.
controls.perTransactionDescription: Max amount for a single top-up, transfer, or withdraw.
controls.dailyOutboundDescription: Max sum of transfers and withdraws per day.
controls.dailyTopUpDescription: Max sum of top-ups into org wallets per day.
controls.dualControlDescription: At or above this amount, a second approver must approve.
controls.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change spending controls.

subscription.sectionDescription: Lifetime allotment of money movements (transfer, withdraw, top-up) for this organization. New organizations start with 1,000 transactions.
subscription.quotaExhausted: Quota used up — transfer, withdraw, and top-up are blocked until a platform admin raises the allotment.

snackbar.dualControlExceedsMax: Dual-control threshold cannot exceed per-transaction maximum
snackbar.usernameMinLength: Username must be at least 3 characters
snackbar.nameMinLength: First and last name must be at least 3 characters
